name: How does a general contractor support home repairs after storm damage?

mainEntity.name: How does a general contractor support home repairs after storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: When restoring a home after storm impacts, a general contractor coordinates multiple repair phases under a single agreement rather than leaving you to manage separate trades. The contractor assesses the damage, secures framing and sheathing, manages drywall removal and moisture repair, and completes the finish restoration with matching texture, trim, and paint. For properties involving insurance claims, having an itemized contractor scope helps homeowners clearly document structural and cosmetic damage for adjusters.
acceptedAnswer.description: A contractor coordinates full restoration—from framing and drywall repair to custom finish carpentry and painting—giving you a single lead for the entire recovery.
